about_the_game:
The Non-Adventure Begins!

Jimmy’s birthday is coming up, and he does NOT want to spend another year of his life in Bakersfield!

As he leaves for his dreamland that is Japan, he also leaves behind a boring version of himself. It’s time for metamorphosis; a change in rhythm to his professional, casual, and love life.

Osaka Law Campus, 2005

Having led a life constantly prosecuted by his peers (and himself), Jimmy flips the script and inspires to become the best civil rights attorney the world has ever seen. Ah, but between his prospects of profession, socialization and love… who has all that time? The people he runs into? We’re looking at the word “questionable” in a rear-view mirror. We go PAST that, slingshot into a lifestyle that only someone as unlucky as Jimmy must endure with the people he’s fated to meet!

The plan

Make. A. Decision.

It’s only 15 Weeks Before Summer! Are you gonna max out your credit on your Modern Phone, or the electricity bill by staying on your Aerosoft computer? Distract yourself with a world tailored to your connections, make the best of it through branching choices and unbelievable dialogue. Or… be the joke of the game… up to you! This game features multiple endings and outcomes, as well as a meter that tracks your reputation and confidence, further reinforcing what Jimmy is built to become.

See you in Osaka!

content_descriptors.notes: (Non-hateful) Vulgar use of language, adult themes, drug use, cartoonish violence, fictional abuse, location based stereotyping, offensive physical descriptions, and general stupidity.

short_description: It’s 15 Weeks Before Summer! New country, new ambitions, new life. Will Jimmy bang the law books, chase love, or focus on his rebirth? Shape his fate in this elusive Adventure Visual Novel, with multiple endings, life meters and the weight of insane expectations. Osaka awaits!
